query: SELECT npc_agent.character_id AS "character_id!: i64" FROM message JOIN history_entry ON history_entry.id = message.id JOIN agent_history ON agent_history.branch_id = history_entry.branch_id JOIN npc_agent ON npc_agent.agent_id = agent_history.agent_id JOIN character_group ON character_group.character_id = npc_agent.character_id WHERE message.id = ? AND character_group.group_id = ?
